title: The limping child
stem: Paediatric area. Kai, 13, overweight, has had a limp and left knee pain for 3 weeks, worse today. Temperature 36.9 °C. Examine him and explain your findings and plan.

phases.title: Examine
phases.goal: Knee pain in a teenager: examine the hip.

phases.title: Explain
phases.goal: What it is, weight-bearing, and the other hip.

notes:
Checked against RCEM/RCPCH guidance on the limping child, the Kocher criteria (septic arthritis), and BOAST 'Slipped capital femoral epiphysis' (2021).

Differential by age: toddler (fracture — toddler's fracture, NAI, DDH, septic arthritis), 3–10 years (transient synovitis, septic arthritis, Perthes), adolescent (SUFE, overuse, tumours); at any age: infection, malignancy, NAI. Hip pathology often presents as knee pain (obturator nerve) — always examine the hip. SUFE: obese adolescent, loss of internal rotation, obligatory external rotation on hip flexion (Drehmann sign); frog-leg lateral X-ray (Klein's line fails to cut the epiphysis). Treatment: non-weight-bearing immediately and urgent orthopaedic referral for pinning; check the other hip. Septic arthritis (Kocher): non-weight-bearing, fever over 38.5, ESR over 40, WCC over 12 (probability rises with number of criteria; CRP over 20 in modified criteria) → aspirate and antibiotics.

Your notes list the limping child ('referred pain from hip to knee'; HSP and NAI in the differential) — this matches.

steps.label: Examine
steps.hint: Gait, both hips and knees, rotations, Drehmann sign, spine, temperature, skin.

Look.r: Antalgic gait with the left foot turned out.
Left leg externally rotated and ~1 cm short.

Knee.r: Normal: no effusion, full range, non-tender.

Hip.r: Left internal rotation markedly reduced and painful.
Hip.mark: Examines the hip: loss of internal rotation

Hip.r: The thigh swings into external rotation as it flexes (Drehmann sign).

Other.r: Afebrile, no rash, spine and abdomen normal.

steps.label: Imaging
steps.hint: AP pelvis and frog-leg laterals of both hips.

X-ray.t: AP pelvis and frog-leg lateral of both hips
X-ray.r: Left femoral epiphysis displaced posteriorly and medially; Klein's line misses the epiphysis.
X-ray.mark: Requests frog-leg laterals and identifies SUFE

X-ray.r: Hip pathology refers to the knee — image the hips.

steps.label: Explain
steps.hint: SUFE, stop weight-bearing now, orthopaedics urgently, other hip.

opts.t: The growth plate at the top of his thigh bone has slipped. He must not put weight on it — crutches or a wheelchair now — and the orthopaedic team will fix it with a pin, usually today or tomorrow.
opts.tz: 佢大髀骨頂嗰塊生長板滑咗位。佢而家唔可以用嗰隻腳承重——要用拐杖或者輪椅，骨科醫生會用鋼針固定，通常今日或者聽日做手術。

opts.t: The other hip can slip too, so it will be checked and watched
opts.tz: 另一邊髖關節都有機會滑，所以我哋都會檢查同跟進。
做物理治療，六個禮拜後覆診。
opts.r: Further slip risks avascular necrosis. This is urgent.

qs.q: X-ray view that best shows SUFE?

qs.a: Transient synovitis: well, afebrile, normal markers
wrong: Septic arthritis: well, afebrile, normal markers
The two cannot be told apart
